Name: Horse to Ostrich (Horse replacer for CP and AT)
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
[center][i]Ever wanted to ride an ostrich into town?
Want to make everyone jealous of your cool ride?
Then, this mod is for you!
[/i][/center]
[left]This mod replaces the horse with an ostrich. That's it.

Please note that at the moment, it's a simple reskin. [b]Don't try giving your ostrich a hat[/b], it will not look good.

If you feel like the galloping sound is weird for your ostrich, feel free to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5780]No Clop If It's Not a Horse it shouldn't gallop[/url]﻿.

[b]Update [/b]: This mod comes in two versions. The classic Content Patcher version which will reskin the horse with an ostrich and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version which allows you to reskin your horse in game. Please note that the AT version will not change the horse icon in your inventory.

You can now choose between two different color variants for your ostrich. The classic vanilla ostrich and the new African ostrich. You can select which variant you want via the config‧json file, but I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/K8qd8Cx2/requirements.png[/img]﻿[/left]
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- (Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gkd9SvNf/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with mostly everything, [b]except [/b]mods that alters the horse's appearance. (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3169]Elle's New Horses[/url])

If you encounter any compatibility issue, please let me know in the Posts tab.

If you like modding your mount, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url] which will give the same overhaul to your lovely ostrich.
